# MachForge - Custom CNC Machining & Prototyping

> MachForge is an on-demand manufacturing service provider located in Shenzhen, China, specializing in precision CNC milling, turning, and rapid prototyping.

## Key Service Capabilities
- CNC Milling & Turning: High-precision 3-axis, 4-axis, and 5-axis machining.
- Materials Supported: Aluminum (6061, 7075), Stainless Steel, Brass, Plastics (POM, ABS, PEEK).
- Surface Finishing: Anodizing, Sandblasting, Powder Coating, Passivation.
- Lead Time: Rapid hardware prototypes delivered in 3-5 business days.
